svg.title: Notifications: direct send, queue and unknown outcomes
svg.desc: Ordinary messages may be durably deferred unless the caller selects reject. Sensitive messages are not automatically retried after quiet hours, expiry or unknown outcomes. Provider acceptance is not final delivery or a read receipt; reconcile unknown results before recovery.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["send: resolve template, provider and destination"] B{"Sensitive credential message?"} C["Ordinary message: apply defer policy"] D["Durably queue an ordinary message"] Q["Return queueId now; not sent yet"] E["Sensitive message: payload-free ledger; check expiry and quiet hours"] F["Call provider; obtain the actual receipt"] G["Record this send outcome"] X["Denied / unknown: report and reconcile; no blind resend"] A --> B B -->|"no"| C B -->|"yes"| E C -->|"defer allowed"| D C -->|"send now"| F D --> Q D -->|"background claim when due"| F E -->|"allowed"| F E -->|"blocked / expired"| X F -->|"receipt received"| G F -->|"unknown result"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class G good; class X stop; class D,Q pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
